public_rationale: The statement has a testable ordinary reading, but the necessary project records are missing. Microsoft's contemporary account reports useful internal tools and substantial savings, providing counterevidence to the broad description. It does not independently measure typical results or fully account for development and repair time. Neither the claimed poor outcomes nor their opposite is established for the projects Zitron describes.
limitations: The speaker's underlying examples are not identified.
Microsoft's account is selective and promotional.
Generic coding productivity studies would not settle this claim about specific internal tools.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The heavy, mandated AI use at hyperscalers should not be read as a sign that AI has taken a leap in efficacy; its actual outcomes are a labyrinth of half-functional internal dashboards that measure random user data or convert files, spending hours to save minutes at some theoretical point.

statement.excerpt: One might be forgiven for thinking this means that AI has taken a leap in efficacy, but the actual outcomes are a labyrinth of half-functional internal dashboards that measure random user data or convert files, spending hours to save minutes of time at some theoretical point.
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: measure random user data or convert files
spending hours to save minutes of time
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that the internal tools produced by the described AI push generally work poorly and cost substantially more human time to build and repair than they save.
This is about the described hyperscaler projects, not every use of AI coding tools.
Time savings must account for repeated use and maintenance. Comparing hours of development with minutes saved on just one use would not fairly test the claim.
For this ongoing observation, the target is March 1–24, 2026, the current reportable month through publication.
The claim concerns observed project quality and returns. It does not by itself establish that mandatory use caused those outcomes.
criteria.support_condition: A representative assessment of the described projects shows substantial missing functionality and development plus repair time measured in hours against only minutes of credible cumulative savings.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative records for the same projects show reliable functionality and substantial net time savings. A successful project is counterevidence to the broad description but cannot alone establish typical results.
